ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram is titled "TERRESTRIAL FOOD WEB." The cougar is shown near the top right of the food web. Arrows point upward toward the cougar from animals such as the deer and rabbit. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows show energy moving from the organism being eaten to the organism that eats it. Since animals like deer and rabbit provide energy to the cougar, the cougar eats other animals. An animal that eats other animals is called a predator.
